notes.title: My Breast Friend Sally Version 2 Releases Just in Time For Summer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37283649/6f519ce908fbcdb29abd753b8f0791bc0392c24c.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, cowpokes![/b]

My Breast Friend Sally Version 2 is almost ready for release with tons of new content.

The new content will be available for free to those who previously purchased the game on Steam.

[b]- Complete application overhaul

- New content for Fiona and Eva

- New minor characters

- New minigames

- GUI fixes

- Remixed Music

- Additional Voice Acting 

- New config features

- Updated menus

- In-app localizations for Chinese (simplified) and Russian, with more to come in future patches 

- Bug fixes[/b]

Have a deMOOnstrably good time!

notes.title: My Breast Friend Sally公告 & 未来改善路线图
notes.content:
随着我们马不停蹄地赶开发，以便及时推出游戏的热潮消退，我们仔细地审视和分析过了来自玩家评测和外部途径的所有正面和负面的反馈。
在认真考虑了大家的意见之后，再结合我们的认知，我们决定拓展游戏内容，从而更贴切地符合粉丝们原本的期望。
为了改善用户的基本游戏体验，我们决定采取以下措施：
- 我们将率先解决所有的技术性Bug，崩溃，文本乱码错位以及小游戏中出现的问题。
- 增加一些QOL（生活质量）改进，包括在视觉小说部分中会出现的加载状态图标，改善过的文本回放，BGM，配音，以及声效大小滑动条等等。
- 游戏中你所找到的所有照片CG将会被拓展成免费的DLC场景，而且它们会和游戏本体你所见到的视听水准相当，甚至质量更高。
- 我们将会在Steam页面和社交媒体上定时公布我们的工作进度更新。

随着上述功能的逐步完善，我们旨在符合你们的期望，并且提供应有尽有的有趣体验。
感谢你们对My Breast Friend Sally的长久支持。我们希望能在农场和你们早日再见。
Kupaa Studios开发团队

notes.title: My Breast Friend Sally Announcements & Future Improvement Roadmap
notes.content:
As we are slowly coming down from the initial release rush of My Breast Friend Sally, we have been carefully looking through and analyzing all the positive and negative feedback we have received from our customer reviews as well as outside sources.

Upon scrupulous consideration of all critical aspects that were pointed out to us, as well as those we were already aware of, we have decided to expand on the content of the game bringing it much closer to what our fans have initially expected.

In order to improve the general user experience of the title we have decided to take the following measures going forward:

- All the technical bugs, crashes, and programming inconsistencies found throughout the visual novel portions of the game as well as the mini-games will be fixed with the utmost priority.

- Adding several QOL (Quality of Life) improvements to the title including a Load State icon in the visual novel portions, an improved text backlog, a BGM, voice, and sound effects volume slider, and more.

- The Eva and Fiona character scenes will be expanded into fully realized free DLC scenes featuring the same and higher level of audio-visual quality you have already seen in the rest of the production.

- We will be issuing regular updates on our Steam page and social media on all the improvements already implemented as we go along.

With all the above features successfully in place, we aim to meet your expectations and provide you with a fun and engaging experience that you deserve.

Thank you for your continued support of My Breast Friend Sally and we hope to see you on the farm again soon enough.

Kupaa Studios Development Team
